$comment: Template for writing.seed.local.json — copy this file to that name and replace the content with your real writing. The real file is gitignored by the *.local.json rule; this example is committed and deliberately contains nothing real. Load it with: .venv/Scripts/python.exe backend/manage.py seed_writing
$scope: This command wipes and reloads ONLY the writing tables. Jobs, tasks, notes, questions and contacts are never touched, so re-seeding your writing cannot cost you your pipeline.
$keys: `key` and `derived_from` are natural keys that exist only in this file — they are resolved to real ids on load and never stored. A fork may appear before the piece it was forked from; lineage is wired in a second pass.
$job: A piece is matched to a job by `company` AND `role` together, because company alone is ambiguous. If no job matches, the piece loads unattached and the command warns — it does not fail.
$passages: Passages are NOT listed here. They are derived from `body` by the same splitter the model uses on save: blank lines separate passages, every markdown list item is its own passage, and headings are dropped. This is why `body` must be real markdown — a single unstructured blob becomes one useless passage and topic search quietly stops working.
$useCount: `passage_use_count` is optional and applies to every passage derived from that piece, seeding the 'most used' sort. Leave it out or use 0 for writing you have not reached for yet.
$types: `type` must be one of the ids in design-system/writing-types.json: resume · cover_letter · blurb · impact_statement.
